神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住在古代：在古代生活，An era is expressed with a time phrase, so use this form rather than treating it as the location after the residence verb. [rule: time_expression]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，At the character’s first mention, introduce the person with a fuller noun phrase so the reader knows who this new character is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 家人常常生病了：家人常常生病，This describes a repeated routine, so use the zero particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们去很多不一样的地方：他们去了很多不一样的地方，This journey action is presented as completed, so the verb needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “住在古代” is acceptable Chinese; “古代” can function as the temporal setting of 住.
This is the character’s first mention, so the teacher requires a fuller introduction.
常常 marks a habitual situation, so 生病 should not take completed-action 了.
The travel to these places is a completed story event, so 去 needs 了.
